_comment: RQ3 for Jessica: all angles at 0.3 m first, then all at 0.8 m, both zones at every angle. Run: python -m rig session --guided --port COM7 --config configs/rq3_jessica.json --out data. Angles are per side (the angle between the sensors is twice that) and run in ascending order; higher angles are skipped once the crosstalk is gone (adaptive_stop_ratio). Square the target with the tape first: measure from one straight reference to each end of the board and make the two equal, then read the tilt that tools/live_ranges.py prints. Put the B minus A it shows on a squared target into square_offset_mm, because the two sensors have their own range offsets. expected_range_mm may be one number per distance, or an angle table (degrees per side -> mm) read between its points, for example {"0": 288, "12": 296}, because a turned sensor reads a little longer once the nearest part of the target leaves the middle of its field.
name: rq3-jessica
